## 3. ヘルパー関数

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 2. ヘルパー関数セクション
# ============================================================================

# データファイルを読み込む共通関数
load_endes_data <- function(year, filename, keep_vars) {
  # ★デバッグ用
  if (is.null(keep_vars) || length(keep_vars) == 0) {
    stop(paste("Error: keep_vars is empty for", filename))
  }
  
  cat("Loading:", filename, "\n")
  cat("Variables to keep:", paste(keep_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  df <- open_endes_file(year, filename) %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>%
    add_missing_columns(keep_vars) %>% 
    dplyr::select(all_of(keep_vars))
  
  return(df)
}

# 出力ディレクトリを準備する関数
setup_output_directory <- function(year) {
  output_dir <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws()
  
  if (!dir_exists(output_dir)) {
    dir_create(output_dir)
  }
  
  return(output_dir)
}


```
## 4. データ処理関数

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 3. データ処理関数セクション
# ============================================================================
# 家族の子供の総数を計算
library(dplyr)

#' ***********************************************************************
#' @title calculate_child_count
#' @description 母親ごとの12歳未満の子供の総数を計算する関数
#' @param df_RECH1 RECH1データフレーム
#' @return 母親ごとの子供の総数を含むデータフレーム
#' @details
#' RECH1データフレームを使用して、各母親ごとに12歳未満の子供の総数を計算します。
#' @examples
#' #' #' # df_RECH1 <- read_dta("path_to_RECH1_data.dta")
#' #' #' # child_count <- calculate_child_count(df_RECH1)
#' #' #' #' # head(child_count)
#' ' @import dplyr
#' ***********************************************************************
calculate_child_count <- function(df_RECH1) {
  cat("計算中: 母親ごとの子供の総数\n")
  
  # 特殊クラスを除去して通常のnumericに変換
  df_clean <- df_RECH1 %>%
    mutate(
      hhid = as.character(hhid),
      hvidx = as.numeric(unclass(hvidx)),  # unclass()で属性を除去
      hv112 = as.numeric(unclass(hv112)),  # unclass()で属性を除去
      hv105 = as.numeric(unclass(hv105)),
      hv102 = as.numeric(unclass(hv102)),
      caseid = as.character(caseid)
    )
  
  # 全メンバーの (hhid, hvidx, caseid) マッピング
  member_lookup <- df_clean %>%
    select(hhid, hvidx, caseid)
  
  cat("メンバー一覧作成完了:", nrow(member_lookup), "件\n")
  
  # 条件を満たす子ども
  children <- df_clean %>%
    filter(
      hv105 <= 12,
      hv102 == 1,
      !is.na(hv112),
      hv112 > 0
    )
  
  cat("条件に合う子供の数:", nrow(children), "\n")
  
  if (nrow(children) == 0) {
    cat("警告: 条件に合う子供が0件です\n")
    return(data.frame(caseid = character(0), dm_children_under12 = numeric(0)))
  }
  
  # 子どもに母親のcaseidを付与
  children_with_mother <- children %>%
    left_join(
      member_lookup,
      by = c("hhid" = "hhid", "hv112" = "hvidx")
    ) %>%
    rename(mother_caseid = caseid.y, child_caseid = caseid.x)
  
  cat("母親とマッチした子供の数:", sum(!is.na(children_with_mother$mother_caseid)), "\n")
  
  # 母親ごとにカウント
  child_count <- children_with_mother %>%
    filter(!is.na(mother_caseid)) %>%
    group_by(mother_caseid) %>%
    summarise(dm_children_under12 = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(caseid = mother_caseid)
  
  cat("子供がいる母親の数:", nrow(child_count), "\n")
  cat("子供の数の分布:\n")
  print(table(child_count$dm_children_under12))
  
  return(child_count)
}
# ---関数ここまで^^---------------------------------------------------------

#' ***********************************************************************
#' @title process_cooking_fuel
#' @description 家庭での燃料使用状況を処理する関数
#' @param IRdata IRデータフレーム
#' @return 燃料使用状況を含むデータフレーム
#' @details
#' 家庭での燃料使用状況に関する変数を処理し、伝統的燃料使用の有無を示す変数を作成。
#' @examples
#' #' # IRdata <- read_dta("path_to_IR_data.dta")
#' #' #' # cooking_fuel <- process_cooking_fuel(IRdata)
#' #' #' # head(cooking_fuel)
#' ' @import dplyr
#' ***********************************************************************
process_cooking_fuel <- function(IRdata) {
  cat("処理中: 家庭での燃料使用状況\n")
  
  cooking_fuel <- IRdata %>%
    mutate(
      dm_cooking_fuel = v161,
      dm_cooking_fuel_traditional = ifelse(dm_cooking_fuel < 7, 0, 1),
      dm_cooking_fuel_traditional = ifelse(is.na(dm_cooking_fuel_traditional), 0, dm_cooking_fuel_traditional)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(caseid, hhid, dm_cooking_fuel, dm_cooking_fuel_traditional)
  
  cat("調理燃料の分布:\n")
  print(table(cooking_fuel$dm_cooking_fuel))
  print(table(cooking_fuel$dm_cooking_fuel_traditional))
  
  return(cooking_fuel)
}
# ---関数ここまで^^---------------------------------------------------------
```

## 5. データ統合関数

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 4. データ統合関数セクション
# ============================================================================

#' ***********************************************************************
#' @title filter_youngest_child_per_mother
#' @description 各母親ごとに最年少の子供を1
#' 人だけ残す関数
#' @param data データフレーム
#' @return 各母親ごとに最年少の子供を1
#' 人だけ残したデータフレーム
#' @details
#' 各母親ごとに最年少の子供を1人だけ
#' 残し、他の行を削除します。条件に
#' 合致しない子供は削除されます。
#' @examples
#' #' # data <- read_dta("path_to_data.dta")
#' #' # filtered_data <- filter_youngest_child_per_mother(data)
#' #' # head(filtered_data)
#' ' @import dplyr
#' @import tidyr
#' @import vctrs
#' ***********************************************************************
filter_youngest_child_per_mother <- function(data) {
  cat("処理開始: 各母親ごとに最年少の子供を1人だけ残す\n")
  
  # 子供のCASEIDを作成してフィルタリング
  filtered_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      # # 母親のCASEIDを作成（HV112が母親の行番号）
      # mother_caseid = if_else(
      #   !is.na(HV112) & HV112 > 0,
      #   paste0(
      #     HHID,
      #     str_pad(as.character(HV112), width = 3, side = "left", pad = " ")
      #   ),
      #   NA_character_
      # ),
      # 月齢の計算（V008とB3から）
      age_months = case_when(
        !is.na(v008) & !is.na(b3) ~ as.numeric(v008 - b3),
        !is.na(b16) ~ as.numeric(b16),  # B16は出生からの月数
        !is.na(hv105) ~ as.numeric(hv105) * 12,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      # 子供が生存しているか（B5）：欠損値は生存と解釈
      child_alive = if_else(is.na(b5), TRUE, b5 == 1),
      # 母親と同居しているか（B9またはHV102）
      living_with_mother = case_when(
        !is.na(b9) ~ b9 == 0,  # B9: 0=母親と同居
        !is.na(hv102) ~ hv102 == 1,  # HV102: 1=通常の居住者
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    # フィルタリング条件
    filter(
      # !is.na(mother_caseid),           # 条件1: 母親IDが存在
      !is.na(age_months),               # 月齢データが存在
      age_months < 23,                  # 条件2: 23ヶ月未満
      child_alive == TRUE,              # 子供が生存
      living_with_mother == TRUE        # 条件3: 同居している
    ) %>%
    # 条件4: 兄弟の中で最も若い子供だけを残す
    group_by(caseid) %>%
    arrange(age_months, bidx) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # 条件5: 複数の母親がいる世帯では、最小CASEIDの母親のみ
    group_by(hhid) %>%
    arrange(caseid) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

  # 結果の確認
  cat("フィルタ後の行数:", nrow(filtered_data), "\n")
  cat("ユニークな母親の数:", n_distinct(filtered_data$caseid), "\n")
  cat("ユニークな世帯の数:", n_distinct(filtered_data$hhid), "\n")

return(filtered_data)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 5. 変数作成関数セクション（修正版）

# 人口統計学的変数を作成（修正版）
#' ***********************************************************************
#' @title create_demographic_variables
#' @description 人口統計学的変数を作成する関数
#' @param data データフレーム
#' @return 人口統計学的変数を含むデータフレーム
#' @details
#' 地域タイプや資産五分位などの人口統計学的変
#' 数を作成します。
#' @examples
#' #' # data <- read_dta("path_to_data.dta")
#' #' #' # demographic_vars <- create_demographic_variables(data)
#' #' #' # head(demographic_vars)
#' ' @import dplyr
#' ***********************************************************************
create_demographic_variables <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    # rename(
    #   v001 = hv001,  # クラスターID
    #   v002 = hv002,  # 世帯ID
    #   v022 = hv022   # 層ID
    # ) %>%
    mutate(
      # 地域タイプ（logical → numeric変換）
      # 地域タイプ（logical → numeric変換）
      dm_rural = as.numeric(
        case_when(
          hv026 == 3 ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )),
      dm_town = as.numeric(
        case_when(
          hv026 == 2 ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )),
      dm_city = as.numeric(
        case_when(
          hv026 == 1 ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )),
      dm_capital = as.numeric(
        case_when(
          hv026 == 0 ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )),
      
      # 資産五分位（logical → numeric変換）
      dm_wealth_class = hv270,
      dm_weath_index = hv271/100000
    )
}
# ---関数ここまで^^---------------------------------------------------------


# 住居・設備関連変数を作成（修正版）
#' ***********************************************************************
#' @title create_housing_variables
#' @description 住居・設備関連変数を作成する関数
#' @param data データフレーム
#' @return 住居・設備関連変数を含むデータフレ
#' ーム
#' @details
#' トイレの共有状況、調理場所、農地・家
#' 畜の所有状況などの住居・設備関連変数を作成します。
#' @examples
#' #' # data <- read_dta("path_to_data.dta")
#' #' #' # housing_vars <- create_housing_variables(data)
#' #' #' # head(housing_vars)
#' ' @import dplyr
#' ***********************************************************************
create_housing_variables <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      # トイレ・調理場所（logical → numeric変換）
      dm_shared_toilet = as.numeric(ifelse(hv238 == 95, 1, 0)),
      dm_cooking_house = as.numeric(ifelse(hv241 == 1, 1, 0)),
      dm_cooking_outdoor = as.numeric(ifelse(hv241 == 3, 1, 0)),
      dm_cooking_separate = as.numeric(ifelse(hv241 == 2, 1, 0)),
      
      # 農地・家畜（logical → numeric変換）
      dm_ag_land_ha = ifelse(hv244 == 0, 0, hv245),
      dm_cattle_own = as.numeric(ifelse(hv246a > 0 & hv246a < 98, 1, 0)),
      dm_goat_own = as.numeric(ifelse(hv246d > 0 & hv246d < 98, 1, 0)),
      dm_sheep_own = as.numeric(ifelse(hv246e > 0 & hv246e < 98, 1, 0)),
      dm_poultry_own = as.numeric(ifelse(hv246g > 0 & hv246g < 98, 1, 0))
    )
}
# ---関数ここまで^^---------------------------------------------------------

# 世帯主関連変数を作成（修正版）
#' ***********************************************************************
#' @title create_household_head_variables
#' @description 世帯主関連変数を作成する関数
#' @param data データフレーム
#' @param var_refrigerator 冷蔵庫所有変数の列名
#' @return 世帯主関連変数を含むデータフレーム
#' @details
#' 冷蔵庫所有、女性世帯主、世帯主の年
#' 齢層などの世帯主関連変数を作成します。
#' @examples
#' #' # data <- read_dta("path_to_data.dta")
#' #' #' # household_head_vars <- create_household_head_variables(data, var_refriger
#' ator = "hv209")
#' #' #' # head(household_head_vars)
#' ' @import dplyr
#' ***********************************************************************
create_household_head_variables <- function(data, var_refrigerator = "hv209") {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      dm_refrigerator = as.numeric(ifelse(get(var_refrigerator) == 1, 1, 0)),
      dm_female_headed = as.numeric(ifelse(hv219 == 2, 1, 0)),
      dm_age_of_HH_head = as.numeric(case_when(
        hv220 < 20 ~ 1,
        hv220 >= 20 & hv220 < 30 ~ 2,
        hv220 >= 30 & hv220 < 40 ~ 3,
        hv220 >= 40 & hv220 < 50 ~ 4,
        hv220 >= 50 & hv220 < 60 ~ 5,
        hv220 >= 60 & hv220 < 70 ~ 6,
        hv220 >= 70 & hv220 < 80 ~ 7,
        hv220 >= 80 ~ 8,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ))
    )
}
```

```{r}
      dm_rural = "living in rural area",
      dm_town = "living in small town",
      dm_city = "living in medium city",
      dm_capital = "living in capital city",
      dm_wealth_class = "wealth index (quintile)",
      dm_weath_index = "wealth index (normalized score)",
      dm_shared_toilet = "shared toilet(10 or more HH)",
      dm_ag_land_ha = "agricultural land (hectare)",
      dm_cooking_house = "cooking inside house",
      dm_cooking_outdoor = "cooking outdoor",
      dm_cooking_separate = "cooking in separate building",

# 値ラベルを設定
#'*************************************************************
#' @title set_all_value_labels
#' @description すべての変数に値ラベルを設定する関
#' 数
#' @param data データフレーム
#' @return 値ラベルが設定されたデータフレーム
#' @details
#' 指定された変数に対して、わかりやすい値ラ
#' ベルを設定します。
#' @examples
#' #' # data <- read_dta("path_to_data.dta")
#' #' #' # labeled_data <- set_all_value_labels(data)
#' #' #' # head(labeled_data)
#' ' @import dplyr
#' *************************************************************
set_all_value_labels <- function(data) {
  # ラベルを設定する列名のリスト
  label_cols <- c("dm_cooking_fuel", "dm_cooking_fuel_traditional", 
                  "dm_rural", "dm_town", "dm_city", "dm_capital",
                  "dm_shared_toilet", "dm_cooking_house",
                  "dm_cooking_outdoor", "dm_cooking_separate", 
                  "dm_cattle_own", "dm_goat_own", "dm_sheep_own",
                  "dm_poultry_own", "dm_refrigerator", 
                  "dm_female_headed", "dm_age_of_HH_head")
  
  data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(label_cols), unclass)) %>%
    set_value_labels(
      dm_cooking_fuel = c(
        "electricity" = 1, "lpg" = 2, "natural gas" = 3, "biogas" = 4, 
        "kerosene" = 5, "coal, lignite" = 6, "charcoal" = 7, "wood" = 8, 
        "straw / shrubs / grass" = 9, "agricultural crop" = 10, 
        "animal dung" = 11, "no food cooked in hh" = 95, "other" = 96, 
        "not dejure resident" = 97
      ),
      dm_cooking_fuel_traditional = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0),
      dm_rural = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0),
      dm_town = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0),
      dm_city = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0),
      dm_capital = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0),
      dm_shared_toilet = c("Yes (10 or more households)" = 1, "No (less than 10 households)" = 0),
      dm_cooking_house = c("Yes (cooking inside house)" = 1, "No (cooking outside or in separate building)" = 0),
      dm_cooking_outdoor = c("Yes (cooking outdoor)" = 1, "No (cooking inside house or in separate building)" = 0),
      dm_cooking_separate = c("Yes (cooking in separate building)" = 1, "No (cooking inside house or outdoor)" = 0),
      dm_cattle_own = c("Yes (owns cattle)" = 1, "No (does not own cattle)" = 0),
      dm_goat_own = c("Yes (owns goats)" = 1, "No (does not own goats)" = 0),
      dm_sheep_own = c("Yes (owns sheep)" = 1, "No (does not own sheep)" = 0),
      dm_poultry_own = c("Yes (owns poultry)" = 1, "No (does not own poultry)" = 0),
      dm_refrigerator = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0),
      dm_female_headed = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0),
      dm_age_of_HH_head = c("10s" = 1, "20s" = 2, "30s" = 3, "40s" = 4,
                            "50s" = 5, "60s" = 6, "70s" = 7, "80+" = 8)
    )
}
# ---関数ここまで^^---------------------------------------------------------

```

## 8. メインループ

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 7. メイン処理関数
# ============================================================================
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)


goAnalysis <- function(year) {
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("ENDES データ統合処理開始:", year, "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n\n")
  
  # 変数リストを取得
  var_lists <- get_variable_lists
  
  # 出力ディレクトリを準備
  output_dir <- setup_output_directory(year)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # データ読み込み
  # ============================================================================
  df_RECH1 <- load_endes_data(year, "RECH1.sav", var_lists$RECH1) %>%
    rename(
      v001 = hv001,  # クラスターID
      v002 = hv002   # 世帯ID
    )
  df_RECH0 <- load_endes_data(year, "RECH0.sav", var_lists$RECH0)
  df_RECH23 <- load_endes_data(year, "RECH23.sav", var_lists$RECH23)
  df_RE516171 <- load_endes_data(year, "RE516171.sav", var_lists$RE516171)
  df_REC0111 <- load_endes_data(year, "REC0111.sav", var_lists$REC0111)
  df_REC21 <- load_endes_data(year, "REC21.sav", var_lists$REC21)
  
  print("caseid" %in% names(df_RECH0))
  print("caseid" %in% names(df_RECH1))
  print("caseid" %in% names(df_RECH23))
  print("caseid" %in% names(df_RE516171))
  print("caseid" %in% names(df_REC0111))
  print("caseid" %in% names(df_REC21))
 
  # ============================================================================
  # データ統合
  # ============================================================================
  cat("\n## 3. データセット統合\n")
  
  # 基本データから開始(ラベル保存)
  labels_RECH0 <- save_labels_to_memory(df_RECH0)
  labels_RECH1 <- save_labels_to_memory(df_RECH1)
  labels_RECH23 <- save_labels_to_memory(df_RECH23)
  labels_RE516171 <- save_labels_to_memory(df_RE516171)
  label_REC0111 <- save_labels_to_memory(df_REC0111)
  label_REC21 <- save_labels_to_memory(df_REC21)
  
  # ラベル情報を除去
  df_RECH0_safe <- remove_labels(df_RECH0)
  df_RECH1_safe <- remove_labels(df_RECH1)
  df_RECH23_safe <- remove_labels(df_RECH23)
  df_RE516171_safe <- remove_labels(df_RE516171)
  df_REC0111_safe <- remove_labels(df_REC0111)
  df_REC21_safe <- remove_labels(df_REC21)
  
  
  # 1. RECH1にCASEID作成
  cat("RECH1にCASEIDを作成中...\n")
  df_RECH1_safe <- df_RECH1_safe %>%
    mutate(caseid = paste0(
      hhid,
      str_pad(as.character(hvidx), width = 3, side = "left", pad = " ")
    ))

  # 2. 世帯レベルのファイルを結合
  cat("世帯レベルデータの結合中:RECH0-RECH23...\n")
  household_data <- df_RECH0_safe %>%
    left_join_safe(df_RECH23_safe, by = "hhid", join_name = "RECH0-RECH23", 
                   diagnose = TRUE)
  
  # 3. 世帯データと世帯メンバーデータを結合
  cat("世帯メンバーデータの結合中:RECH1-Household...\n")
  household_member_data <- df_RECH1_safe %>%
    left_join_safe(household_data, by = "hhid", 
                   join_name = "RECH1-Household", diagnose = TRUE)

  # 4. 個人レベルのファイルを結合（女性の情報）
  cat("個人レベルデータの結合中:REC0111-RE516171...\n")
  individual_data <- df_REC0111_safe %>%
    left_join_safe(
      df_RE516171_safe, by = "caseid", join_name = "REC0111-RE516171", 
      diagnose = TRUE
    )

  # 5. 世帯メンバーと個人データを結合
  cat("世帯メンバーと個人データの結合中:Household-Individual...\n")
  combined_data <- household_member_data %>%
    left_join_safe(individual_data, by = "caseid", 
                join_name = "Household-Individual", diagnose = TRUE)

  # 6. REC21（出生履歴）を結合
  # 注意: REC21は1人の母親に複数行あるので、慎重に結合
  final_data <- combined_data %>%
    left_join_safe(df_REC21_safe, by = "caseid", diagnose = TRUE)
  
  cat("最終データ行数:", nrow(final_data), "\n")
  cat("元のRECH1行数:", nrow(df_RECH1), "\n")
  
  # 結果の確認
  cat("フィルタ後の行数:", nrow(final_data), "\n")
  cat("ユニークな母親の数:", n_distinct(final_data$caseid), "\n")
  cat("ユニークな世帯の数:", n_distinct(final_data$hhid), "\n")
      
  IRdata <- final_data
  
  
  # ============================================================================
  # データ処理
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 2. データ処理\n")
  
  # 子供の数を計算
  child_count <- calculate_child_count(df_RECH1_safe)
  print("子供の数の分布確認:")
  print(names(child_count))
  
  
  # 調理燃料を処理
  cooking_fuel <- process_cooking_fuel(IRdata)
  print("調理燃料の分布確認:")
  print(names(cooking_fuel))
  
  # データ結合
  IRdata <- left_join_safe(
    IRdata, cooking_fuel, by=c("hhid", "caseid"), 
    join_name = "IRdata-cooking_fuel", diagnose = TRUE)
  IRdata <- left_join_safe(
    IRdata, child_count, by=c("caseid"), 
    join_name = "IRdata-child_count", diagnose = TRUE)

  # 調理燃料マッチング確認
  cat("調理燃料マッチング確認:\n")
  print(table(IRdata$dm_cooking_fuel))
  matched_count <- IRdata %>% summarise(n_matched = sum(!is.na(dm_cooking_fuel)))
  print(matched_count)
  

  # 年情報を追加
  IRdata <- IRdata %>% mutate(year = year)
  
  

  cat("統合完了 - レコード数:", nrow(IRdata), "\n\n")
  

  # ============================================================================
  # 女性のエンパワーメント指標作成
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 4. 女性エンパワーメント指標作成\n")
  source(here("Chap15_WE", "WE_EMPW_update.R"), local = environment())

  cat("エンパワーメント指標作成後の確認:\n")
  print(table(WEdata$dm_cooking_fuel))
  print(table(WEdata$dm_children_under12))
  print(table(WEdata$dm_decide_health))

  # ============================================================================
  # 最終変数作成
  # ============================================================================
  cat("\n## 5. 最終変数作成\n")
  
  HRdata <- WEdata
  print(names(WEdata))
  HRdata <- WEdata %>%
    create_demographic_variables() %>%
    create_housing_variables() %>%
    create_household_head_variables() %>%
    mutate(year = year)

  # 必要な変数のみ選択
  vars_to_keep <- HRdata %>%
    dplyr::select(starts_with("dm")) %>%
    names() %>%
    append(c("year", "v001", "v002", "v005", "v022", "caseid", "hhid"))

  # 月齢の計算用変数（V008とB3から）
  age_variable <- c("v008", "b3", "b5", "b9", "hv102", "b16", "hv105", "bidx")
  vars_to_keep <- append(vars_to_keep, age_variable)

  HRdata <- HRdata %>% dplyr::select(all_of(vars_to_keep))
  
  # # 最終重複チェック
  duplicate_check(HRdata, c("caseid"), "HRdata")
  
  # 母親・一番若い児童<24、同居の条件でフィルター
  HRdata <- filter_youngest_child_per_mother(HRdata)
  HRdata <- HRdata %>% select(-age_variable)

  # ============================================================================
  # ラベル設定
  # ============================================================================
  # ラベル復元
  HRdata <- restore_labels(HRdata, labels_RECH0) %>%
    restore_labels(labels_RECH1) %>%
    restore_labels(labels_RECH23) %>%
    restore_labels(labels_RE516171) %>%
    restore_labels(label_REC0111) %>%
    restore_labels(label_REC21)

  
  cat("## 6. ラベル設定\n")
  # ラベル設定でエラーが発生した時以下の行を実行
  # diagnose_value_label_issues(HRdata)
  if (year == "2016") {
    cat("2016年の変数ラベルを更新します\n")
    HRdata <- HRdata %>%
      set_all_variable_labels() %>%
      set_all_value_labels_safe()
  } else {
    HRdata <- HRdata %>%
      set_all_variable_labels() %>%
      set_all_value_labels()
    }

  # ============================================================================
  # 保存
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 7. ファイル保存\n")
  saveRDS(HRdata, paste0(output_dir, "/HRdata-dm.rds"))
  cat("WASHdata保存完了:", year, "\n")
  
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("処理完了:", year, ": データ数", nrow(HRdata), "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  
  return(HRdata)
}

```

## 9. 実行
```{r}
#** ここから実行
temp <- list()
for (yr in yearlist) {
  if (yr %in% c("2005", "2012")) {
    cat("*********************************************************************", "\n")
    cat("** スキップ:", yr, "\n")
    warning("** 2005年と2012年はこのスクリプトの対象外です。")
    cat("*********************************************************************", "\n")
    next
  }
  temp[[yr]] <-  goAnalysis(yr)
}
```
